objective: Add the DynamoDB, Bedrock and storage backend for AI covers, with the SDK clients injected.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Create src/lib/ai-cover-backend.ts exactly as specified in the acceptance test header. It returns the CoverBackend interface exported by src/lib/ai-cover-service.ts (shown), mirroring the descriptionBackend pattern: consistent reads, the budget record converted to plain values, one model call, and a conditional final update.

Reuse existing helpers, importing each with its explicit .ts extension so Node tests can load it: AI_COVER_MODEL and the AiCoverStyle type from ./ai-cover.ts; AI_COVER_TABLE, AI_COVER_PARTITION, coverBudgetAvailability(budget, now, commit) and coverReservationTransaction(id, owner, item, style, request, now, commit) from ./ai-cover-budget.ts; coverObjectPath and the CoverBackend type from ./ai-cover-service.ts. Only ai-cover-service.ts is shown; none of these modules may change.
Every DynamoDB, Bedrock and storage call goes through the injected deps; this module must not import AWS SDKs, Supabase, React or server-only, and must not read files, the network or process.env.
Keep the change small: one module and one focused test file; a repair should change only what its findings require.
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks, together with the existing ai-cover acceptance tests; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
source_manifest_note: Computed by the coding assistant from a separate read-only clone with both the Factory reader and the owner's standalone script (116 files, 729223 bytes); the Factory fetch verifies it independently before use.
